paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben Elisha. (a Tanna of the baraita).

Shabbat 139a preserves his valuable saying: “If you see a generation afflicted with many troubles, investigate the judges of Israel, for every calamity that comes into the world comes only because of the judges of Israel.” Hyman suggests the abbreviated name R”Y may have meant Rabbi Yishmael ben Elisha.

notes.text: Hyman suggests that an abbreviated R”Y originally denoted Yishmael rather than Yose. Ben Elisha is expanded from the connected heading’s father name; the proposed identification remains tentative.
The consulted Shabbat 139a explicitly names Yose ben Elisha. Hyman’s suggested expansion of an earlier abbreviation as Yishmael ben Elisha remains conjectural.
